description: This file contains the implementation of the DataElement class and its related LinkedDataElement class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes methods for CRC32 calculation, buffer access, and data copying functionalities, indicating its role in data management or processing within the core of the application.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with CRC32 checksum capabilities and buffer management within the core namespace.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A linked list node for data buffers supporting segmented data storage, with methods for buffer access, modification, and copying.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum over a segment of the buffer starting at a given offset for a specified size.

methods.name: void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer at a specified offset into a provided external buffer, handling boundary crossing if needed.

methods.name: void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer at a specified offset from an external buffer, handling boundary crossing if needed.

methods.name: uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, starting at a specified offset, handling segment boundaries.
